rule: A frozen Quant V2 comparison is valid only if every output-affecting execution semantic remains identical to the canonical baseline. The only permitted experimental delta is the asset universe. Any other change requires explicit Founder approval and a successor quantitative version.
forbidden_comparison_harness_behaviors: runtime replacement or monkey-patching of size_trade
normalized-R substitution for canonical broker/spec sizing
replacement of canonical promotion, ranking, risk, execution or management semantics
different starting currency or starting-equity convention
silent narrowing to assets supported by an adapter while calling the result full-universe
new outcome-driven selection or changed validation gates
mandatory_preconditions: canonical $100 26-week golden replay identity passes before expanded-universe replay
comparison harness contains no prohibited runtime overrides
any inability to process the expanded universe fails closed rather than changing strategy semantics
